title: Ever Works — Agent Template
description: YAML frontmatter contract for every SOUL.md template in this repo. Mirrors the user-settable fields on the platform's Agent entity (packages/agent/src/entities/agent.entity.ts).

slug.description: Unique slug, kebab-case. `starter-*` is reserved for built-in templates shipped from this repo.

name.description: Short display name shown in the wizard chip (e.g. 'PM', 'Coder').

scope.description: Default scope the wizard pre-selects. The user can change it.

summary.description: One-sentence description shown under the template card in the wizard.

capabilities.description: Multi-line description of what the agent does. Mapped to Agent.capabilities.

avatarIcon.description: Lucide icon name. Required when avatarMode = ICON. Picked from https://lucide.dev/icons.

aiProviderId.description: Optional preferred provider slug (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai'). Leave empty to use the tenant default.

modelId.description: Optional preferred model id (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6'). Leave empty to use the tenant default.

heartbeatCadence.description: Cron expression. `null` (or omitted) means manual / no heartbeat.

suggestedSkills.description: Slugs of recommended skills the wizard pre-checks. Skills repo lands separately.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering in the wizard.
